		(descr "TI UCC21550BDWK, 14-pin DWK package, on TI's HV / ISOLATION OPTION land pattern (SLUSE89C, Aug 2024; land-pattern drawing 4224374/A). SLUSE89C publishes TWO land patterns side by side for DWK0014A: 'IPC-7351 NOMINAL' (14X 2mm x 0.6mm pads on a 9.3mm centre span, stated 7.3 mm CLEARANCE/CREEPAGE) and 'HV / ISOLATION OPTION' (14X 1.65mm x 0.6mm pads on a 9.75mm centre span, stated 8.1 mm CLEARANCE/CREEPAGE); both use 11X 1.27mm pitch. THIS FOOTPRINT IS THE HV / ISOLATION OPTION. It was previously the IPC-7351 nominal geometry (KiCad Package_SO:SOIC-16W_7.5x10.3mm_P1.27mm with pads 12/13 deleted), which measured 9.30 - 1.025 - 1.025 = 7.250mm of HV-to-SELV copper separation and so threw away ~0.85mm of the part's own >8mm external clearance and creepage (SLUSE89C section 5.6, CLR and CPG), against the 8.0mm MIN_BARRIER_WIDTH_MM enforced by scripts/check_isolation_keepout.py. SLUSE89C footnote (1) to the Insulation Specifications table states the requirement directly: 'Care should be taken to maintain the creepage and clearance distance of a board design to ensure that the mounting pads of the isolator on the printed-circuit board do not reduce this distance.' On this land the same measurement is 9.75 - 0.825 - 0.825 = 8.100mm. CHANGED 2026-07-28: pad size 2.05x0.6 -> 1.65x0.6, pad row centres +/-4.65 -> +/-4.875, courtyard X +/-5.93 -> +/-5.95, pin-1 silk marker moved with pad 1. Pad Y positions, pitch, numbering (1-11, 14-16), body silk and F.Fab outline are unchanged. DWK is fabricated on the same 16-lead frame with 2 leads omitted at physical positions 12 and 13 -- per SLUSE89C's absolute-maximum table that omission buys channel-A-to-channel-B isolation (|VSSA-VSSB| in DWK = 1850 V), NOT primary-to-secondary creepage, which is what the land pattern above governs. The Pin Configuration diagram (Section 4, Figure 4-2) lists DWK pin numbers as 1-11 then 14-16, skipping 12/13 entirely. The 3D model reference below is the 16-pin DW step file kept as a visual approximation (it will render 2 phantom leads at the omitted positions) -- no DWK-specific step model was available in the fetched datasheet.")
